# Links

An inline link to [the target](./linked.md).

An image: ![a picture](./linked.md)

A fragment link to [the section](./linked.md#target-section).

A bare URL: https://example.com/docs

A reference link to [the reference][ref].

A shortcut reference to [ref].

[ref]: ./linked.md

An anchor in this file: [the tail](#tail).

A line with [first](./linked.md) and [second](./other.md) on it.

A path that is not a link: ./linked.md

An autolink: <https://example.com/auto>

An anchor-only link: [jump](#tail)

A link in a code span: `[not a link](./linked.md)`

An escaped bracket: \[not a link](./linked.md)

## Tail

The tail.
